comment: Group-scoped data. A group id is 26 characters of a 32-symbol alphabet
(~130 bits) created on the device and shared with your playing partners.
Rules never permit listing groups, only reading and writing one whose id
you already hold, so two unrelated installs can never see each other.
legacy_comment: Unscoped paths used by installs that predate groups. Remove these three
blocks — and the data under them — once every device has upgraded.
